incidents.summary: St. James's Place agreed to set aside £426 million to refund overcharged clients, with an ombudsman compensation order in January 2025 and reported delays in paying some clients.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: The chief executive, Mark FitzPatrick, apologised and agreed to set aside £426 million to refund the clients who had been overcharged.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: In January 2025, in a test case, the financial ombudsman ordered the company to pay compensation.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: In February 2025, The Times reported that some clients had been waiting for years for compensation that had been promised by the company but had not been received.

incidents.summary: A Which? investigation accused St. James's Place of misleading customers about charges and sent its findings to the Financial Conduct Authority.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: In July 2017 an investigation by Which? accused St James's Place of misleading customers on charges.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: The findings of the investigation were sent to the Financial Conduct Authority.

incidents.summary: Fourteen former footballers sued St. James's Place for £15 million over allegedly poor advice concerning tax-avoidance investment schemes, which the company said its partner was not authorised to recommend.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: In November 2019 fourteen former footballers sued St James's Place for £15m, alleging that they had received poor advice concerning tax avoidance regarding film and overseas property investment schemes.

sources.title: St. James's Place plc
sources.quote: A spokesman for St James's Place said the partner was not authorised to direct investors to the plan, and that the proposal was not approved by St James's.
